name: bci2b_within
note: BCI IV 2b (bnci2014_004): 9 subjects, 6,520 trials, and only THREE electrodes -- C3, Cz, C4. Two things make it worth a cell of its own. (1) It is the extreme test of the spatial mixer: with 3 inputs a C->88 dense mix is 29x over-complete, so if the mixer is the component that encodes subject identity, this is where it should hurt most. (2) It is the only corpus here with 5 sessions per subject, which is the one place the session-local alignment question can actually be asked. 2-class, so chance is 50%.
